# hmm ventures

> hmm ventures Fund I is an APAC-sourced venture fund that leads pre-permission rounds, investing before a company's technology has earned permission to enter its market. It backs regulated technology across the energy, food and healthcare systems in Australia, Japan and New Zealand. The thesis: necessity is the thesis. Value migrates to whoever holds the regulated layer as the regulation clock and the technology clock advance.

## Pages

- [Thesis](https://hmm.ventures/): the Fund I thesis, in the order it is argued. What hmm backs and why it is the right buyer of that risk; Power, Eat and Heal as systems, each with one physical instance and the unit it is sold by; the capability arriving in the physical layer; permission as a locator for the fund and a barrier for the company, with the enacted instrument record; and the screen that takes ten markets to three.
- [The GP](https://hmm.ventures/bio.html): Wahid Tashkandi, general partner of hmm ventures.
- [Sources](https://hmm.ventures/sources.html): primary and first-party sources behind the thesis, each row naming the issuer and the edition.
- [Context for AI assistants](https://hmm.ventures/for-llms.html): canonical framing for summarising hmm ventures, and common misattributions to avoid.
